answers.core: Unless sensors behind the screen become the next standard, notches and punch holes are going to be visible on many phones to come, so having a built-in way to work around them (or with them) could be helpful.
answers.workaround: I think the only way to work around this would be to write an Android plugin (I have no experience with those, but I assume it's doable).

title: Add function to get mobile device's notch position and size on iOS (already implemented on Android)
